response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_avg_daily_price AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS overall_avg FROM rating_stats), above_average_ratings AS (SELECT rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.avg_daily_price, rs.avg_daily_price - oap.overall_avg AS excess FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_avg_daily_price oap WHERE rs.avg_daily_price > oap.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM above_average_ratings;
